risk_note: RV2 (content system switch port for BR-FUND-19 / 20; no amounts). Exported port turnOff turns only settle.auto.enabled off inside the caller's transaction (rejects a non-transaction, any other key, extra fields), actor system without step-up: locks the row FOR UPDATE, inserts version 1 with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING when absent and re-locks, a stored false is a no-op, otherwise a conditional update on the locked version; writes a switch history row (updated_by system, no admin id, reason source:reason) instead of audit_logs, whose admin_id is a non-null foreign key (approved default D-S4); the alert is emitted only by alertCommitted after the caller commits. Admin switch writes and the switch registry are unchanged. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
